//: Things the captain can look at. Script ids start with 'inspect.'.

then: Charts of the Windward Passage, weighed down with a compass and last night's cold coffee.
The top drawer sticks, as it always does. Inside: the <y>Captain's Key</>.
else: Charts, dividers and a candle stub. The course is in Nell's neat hand; the curses in the margin are yours.

start: Your bed. Feather mattress, red wool blanket. The only soft thing aboard.
rest: You rest your eyes for a turn of the glass. You feel ready to shout at someone again.

then: (HP fully restored. Resting in your own bed is always free.)

inspect.stern_windows: Through the stern windows the wake unspools behind {ship}. Somewhere back there is yesterday. You don't miss it.
inspect.portrait: A portrait of yourself, in oils. The artist was paid handsomely to add a few inches.
inspect.helm: She's seen better days, but she still answers the helm.

then: nell: South-sou'west, Captain. Wind's steady on the quarter. She'll hold it till nightfall.

start: The ship's bell, polished bright. It marks the watches.

then: crew: Is that the watch? That's not the change of watch! Who rang the—
captain[smug]: Just making sure it still works.
else: Somewhere below, several sailors groan in unison.

inspect.flag: Your colours: a skull wearing a proper beard, over two crossed cutlasses. Merchants have been known to surrender on sight.
inspect.stew: A cauldron of something brown. It's either stew or bilge, and Mags will be very hurt if you ask which.
inspect.dunstan: sleeper: Hnnrk... five more minutes, Mother...
Dunstan of the middle watch. You'll deal with him later. Probably with a bucket.

then: Finch's old sea chest. Empty now, save for the smell of pipe tobacco and forty years of stories.
else: An old sea chest with a fish carved on the lid. Locked. The keyhole is crusted with rust.

then: This must be Old Finch's chest. The one he lost the key to.

inspect.treasure_door_locked: The treasure hold door: iron-bound oak and a lock the size of your fist.
Locked. Even your own crew doesn't get free access to this.
captain[annoyed]: And my key is still in my desk. Of course it is.
inspect.hoard: The ship's treasure: gold, silver, and a few things too pretty to spend. Every coin is in Quill's ledger.

else: captain[smug]: Still here. Still mine. Mostly.

inspect.treasure_ledger: Quill's inventory of the treasure hold, in a hand so neat it is almost threatening.
“One crown, jewelled. One idol, gold, emerald eyes (Finch objects). Four thousand two hundred and eleven coins, assorted.”
“Note: the Captain took one (1) doubloon on the 14th of March, for luck. To be returned.”
captain[annoyed]: He's still counting that one.
